settings.title: System Settings
settings.description: Manage database, LLM Provider, and novel generation workflow configurations

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.description: Protect local novels, chapters, factions, and relationships. Model API keys are never included in data backups.
backup.automaticDescription: On startup, the app creates at most one snapshot every {hours} hours and keeps the latest {count} files.
backup.noBackupYet: No automatic backup yet. The first one will be created on the next successful backend startup.
backup.manualDescription: Download a JSON file containing all novel data for long-term storage on another drive.
backup.restoreDescription: Choose a full JSON backup created by this app. A safety snapshot of the current database is saved first.
backup.restoreWarningTitle: This replaces all current novel data
backup.restoreWarning: Restore from “{name}”. Current data is written to a pre-restore safety snapshot before replacement.
backup.restoreSuccess: Restore complete. Return to the bookshelf to review your data.
backup.restoreFailed: Restore failed. The app attempted to recover the previous data.
backup.fileTooLarge: Backup files must not exceed 100 MB

provider.title: LLM Provider Management
provider.subtitle: Test API capabilities and fill the current form; saving writes them to the config file
provider.empty: No Provider yet. Add one first.
provider.renameHint: Renaming will also update the default provider, format review provider, and every workflow reference.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: This test uses the current form values and does not require saving first

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Test results initialize these toggles, and you can still adjust them manually

test.title: Capability Test
test.description: Runs 5 tiny requests, uses a small number of tokens, and does not save config
test.appliedHint: Suggested values were filled into this form. Click Save to write them to the config file.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.description: Deleting a Provider also clears related defaults and workflow references.

provider.mustExist: Default Provider must exist in the configured list

genParams.title: Generation Parameters (Optional)
genParams.hint: Configure default generation parameters for this provider. When enabled, these values will be used as defaults unless overridden per request.
genParams.systemPromptPlaceholder: Enter default system prompt for this provider...

workflow.title: Novel Generation Workflow
workflow.description: Manage Provider assignment for built-in workflows. Each workflow can keep its own default Provider and override Provider or timeout per step.
workflow.workflowListHint: Fixed workflows are provided by implemented modules
workflow.workflowNameRule: Workflow name can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores
workflow.formatReviewHint: Used to fix malformed AI responses; must support JSON Schema
workflow.stepNameRule: Step name can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores
workflow.customStepHint: Custom workflow step; backend resolves Provider by workflow_name + step_name
workflow.timeoutPositive: Step timeout must be greater than 0

steps.expand_idea_to_full_novel_story: Expand the user idea into a full compressed long-form plot
steps.extract_idea: Extract core story elements from user idea
steps.core_seed: Generate story core seed from elements
steps.create_core_factions: Generate full-book core factions and faction relations from saved novel info

workflow.providerDisabled: Selected Provider is disabled, enable it manually after saving

validation.providerNotExist: Referenced Provider does not exist, cannot save
validation.workflowProviderNotExist: Workflow step references a non-existent Provider, cannot save

bookshelf.title: My Bookshelf
bookshelf.emptyGuide: Your bookshelf is empty. Click "New Novel" to start your creative journey!
bookshelf.noSelection: Select a novel from the left to view details, or create a new one
bookshelf.deleteConfirm: Confirm to delete "{title}"? This can be restored.
bookshelf.hardDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete "{title}"? This action CANNOT be undone.
bookshelf.aiCompleteRedirect: AI generation complete, redirecting to writing desk...

novel.title: Title
novel.subtitle: Subtitle

create.title: Create Novel
create.ideaPlaceholder: Describe the story you want to write, e.g.: A loser teenager awakens a time-reversal ability in a post-apocalyptic world...
create.reviewDescription: You can modify the results below, then save to create the novel

genParams.title: Generation Parameters (Optional), if you don't understand, please do not enable or modify
genParams.hint: Override LLM generation parameters for this creation session. If not set, provider defaults will be used.
genParams.systemPromptPlaceholder: Enter a system prompt to guide the AI generation style...

novelInfo.createDescription: The following info was generated by AI. Review and adjust before saving.
novelInfo.noDraft: No draft found. Please start AI creation from the bookshelf.

chapterEditor.emptyStructureDescription: Create a volume, then add chapters. Counts and word totals stay in sync automatically.
chapterEditor.summaryPlaceholder: Note this chapter's goal, conflict, or important setup...
chapterEditor.autosaveHint: Autosaves about 1 second after typing · Ctrl+S saves now
chapterEditor.selectChapterTitle: Select a chapter to start writing
chapterEditor.selectChapterDescription: Expand a volume and choose a chapter, or create a new chapter in the selected volume.
chapterEditor.loadFailedDescription: Your local draft is safe. Check the backend and database connection, then retry.
chapterEditor.createModeTitle: Save the novel to start writing chapters
chapterEditor.createModeDescription: This novel is still a local creation draft. Save it from Novel Info to unlock the volume tree, autosave, and export tools.

outline.volumeDescription: AI splits the whole book into volumes based on the novel settings. Accepting creates the volumes and chapter stubs.
outline.rangeHint: Chapter range validity (no overlaps, no gaps, exact coverage) is checked on the server and only reported when you accept.
outline.truncationWarning: Context exceeded the budget. These sections were truncated: {sections}
outline.paramSystemPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the configured default
outline.chapterDescription: AI drafts an outline for this chapter from the existing settings and earlier chapters. Accepting writes it to the chapter and creates the proposed new plot threads.
outline.rosterLoadFailed: Failed to load options; ids will be shown raw: {error}
outline.droppedIdsWarning: AI referenced {count} ids that do not exist; they were removed: {detail}
outline.threadsResolvedNotice: Accepting an outline does not remove a plot thread from later chapters' active list. The actual status transition happens during state backfill in a later phase, once the prose confirms the thread was really resolved.
outline.orphanThreadsNotice: This replaced an earlier outline. The {count} threads created last time are now orphaned and are not cleaned up automatically (there is no way to tell which were hand-edited): {names}
outline.existingTitle: This chapter already has an outline
outline.existingHint: An accepted outline can be edited directly (saving only changes fields and keeps the planted threads). Regenerating instead replaces it wholesale, and the threads created last time become orphans that need manual cleanup.
outline.regenerateWarning: Regenerate? The current outline will be replaced.
outline.threadsPlantedReadonlyHint: Threads planted in this chapter are read-only here. To add or remove threads, use the Plot Threads workspace, or regenerate the whole outline.

batch.startButtonTitle: Batch-generate prose for the selected volume (auto-generate + accept each chapter, pausing every N chapters for review)
batch.startBookButtonTitle: Batch-generate prose across all volumes (auto-generate + accept each chapter, pausing every N chapters for review)
batch.dialogCheckpointHint: Pause for review every N chapters (N=1 ≈ per-chapter gate)
batch.dialogTokenHint: Pauses at a chapter boundary once reached; a rough cap, not exact billing
batch.progressTokensNote: (rough; failed chapters' spent tokens not counted)
batch.reasonCheckpoint: Reached a planned checkpoint. Review this window, then resume.
batch.reasonConflict: Consistency conflict hit — paused. Review the conflicts below before resuming.
batch.reasonCostCap: Token budget reached; paused at a chapter boundary. Raise the budget and resume, or abort.
batch.reasonInterrupted: Interrupted last time (backend restart). Resumable from where it stopped.
batch.failedBody: Failed at {step}: {message}. Resume = retry from the failed sub-step.
batch.windowEmpty: No completed chapters in this window yet.
batch.resultCompleted: Volume complete: {count} chapters this run, ~{tokens} tokens total.
batch.resultCompletedBook: Book complete: {count} chapters this run, ~{tokens} tokens total.
batch.abortConfirmBody: This immediately cuts off the running generation; the current half-chapter is discarded. Completed chapters are kept.

prose.title: AI Write Chapter
prose.description: Generates prose from this chapter's outline and context package. Accepting writes it into the editor; autosave persists it.
prose.incomplete: Incomplete: generation was interrupted. Below is what was written so far. You can accept it as is or regenerate.
prose.needOutline: This chapter has no accepted outline yet. Generate and accept one under "AI chapter outline" first.
prose.overwriteArm: This chapter already has content. Accepting replaces all of it.
prose.acceptedNotice: Prose written to the editor. Review it, then save.
